title: DS lexer contract
preamble:
# DS lexer contract

The lexer's contract. Paired with
[LGRA], which carries the parser productions
(BNF) and the prose / disambiguation rules.

The lexer turns a UTF-8 source file into a token stream the
parser consumes. Everything the parser grammar assumes — that
comments are gone, that blank lines don't appear, that
`INDENT` / `DEDENT` / `NEWLINE` mark block structure, that
`-->` is one token not two — is the lexer's responsibility to
deliver.

This spec is authoritative for the lexer's behaviour. A
conforming implementation of DS must produce the token stream
specified here; the parser is written against this stream, not
the raw source.

## What this is not

- Not the parser grammar — see [LGRA].
- Not the string-interpolation sub-grammar — interpolation
  sites `{…}` inside string literals are parsed in a second
  pass over the already-lexed `STRING_LIT` content (see
  [LGRA.11] / [LGRA.2.9.6]).
- Not an implementation guide for a specific parser-generator
  tool. The rules here can be implemented in any framework and
  need no parser-state-dependent lexing ([LLEX.10.7]).
